prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create a premium product concept design board for OUR WORLD, a private app for REAL friends and couples to chat, save memories, listen to music, and play with a shared atmospheric room. ALL people are adult USER AVATARS, not AI companions. Images are aspirational visual concepts, NOT screenshots or evidence of an actual renderer. Make a large, very polished landscape board, ideally 2400x1600. Three clearly separated areas: top left 72 percent width a large desktop app preview; top right 28 percent width an upright smartphone app preview of the SAME room; bottom strip two broad equal panels: a clean scene detail and a coherent FOUR-person version of the SAME room. Tiny English heading only, sharp restrained typography. In desktop preview roughly 60 percent scene remains visible and 40 percent is a readable CHAT sidebar; characters and faces must remain in the visible scene. Top compact app branding, navigation "Room  Chat  Memories  Music". Sidebar 3 short plausible messages: "Made tea for you.", "I'll stay for one song.", "Stay a little longer." Composer "Say something..." A subtle music footer reads "Evening together" with play control. Phone: top 45 percent is a deliberately composed close scene showing both avatars, bottom 55 percent chat with legible comfortable type; do not simply squeeze a landscape desktop. No fake gameplay counters, XP, coins, chores, romance meters, dashboards or extensive text. Product visual identity: smoked neutral glass outer chrome, opaque warm ivory readable content, charcoal text, soft amber highlights. Illustration/3D art must be stunning but cleanly separated from functional reading surfaces. Do not put blur or transparent text over detailed artwork. All avatars keep identity across views. Foreground occlusion, medium-distance furniture and far windows should create convincing spatial depth. The common setting is a private rain-at-blue-hour living/listening room with amber lamplight, vinyl player, tea, a small handwritten keepsake and a leafy plant. NO existing IP, no children or school uniforms, no sexualization, no watermarks.
Title text "A / A ROOM FOR US" and subtitle "Cinematic 2.5D". PRODUCT: intimate side-by-side companionship, rich painterly anime CG drawn as sophisticated layered 2D key art with subtle depth, soft brush texture and beautiful visible cast shadows. Camera close at seated eye level, not top down. Two attractive relatable adult people, woman with loose dark bob and oatmeal cardigan, man with short dark hair and muted teal sweater, seated adjacent at a low table. Both are fully in the composition, not viewer POV; woman's quiet glance toward partner, man reaching toward two cups. Characters occupy meaningful 30-40 percent image height. Large near window frame and leaves occlude corners, rain-lit city far behind. Bold diagonal warm window/pendant beam, cool blue rainy ambient fill, contact shadows under arms and furniture, controlled luminous edges; dark-to-light composition with depth, no overall orange haze. Scene detail bottom left is the human moment of a cup with a tiny handwritten note, reaching hands and eye contact. Four-person bottom right opens framing modestly to two people on couch plus two around the same table, two women and two men with distinct adult faces, NOT a huge room and not a row of portrait cards. Beautiful animation-film background quality; the promised runtime is layered 2.5D, no real time 3D claim.

Title text "B / OUR LITTLE PLACE" and subtitle "Stylized 3D diorama". PRODUCT: a tiny shared place that friends inhabit and tinker with together. The art looks like a beautifully crafted realtime-friendly 3D miniature, not a painting and not a plastic toy for children. Grown-up stylized human avatars, about 5-head proportions with clearly adult clothing and expressions, rounded yet articulated forms, matte porcelain-like skin, sculpted hair clumps, fabric and wood with simplified restrained texture. Woman dark bob oatmeal cardigan, man short dark hair muted teal sweater. Camera is a medium close three-quarter low diorama camera, about 20 degree downward, SHOW ONE open room only; enough perspective and near furniture overlap to feel volumetric, do not make a huge distant dollhouse grid. Warm walnut, moss sofa, cream ceramics, thick rainy bay window, cool slate night exterior. Clear cast shadows from one amber lamp, baked-looking soft indirect lighting, single warm key and cool fill, tame restrained reflections, no raytraced-showreel excess. Desktop shows two adult avatars passing a tea cup at couch table. Bottom left a close-up of a tactile tabletop toy: four blocks balanced in a tiny tower, a hand about to add one, small earned delight without any reward UI. Bottom right FOUR distinct adult friends distributed around L-shaped sofa and table, no duplicate figures, no seating rows. Figures readable at phone scale. Environment geometry and loose objects create a sense that you can turn a lamp, set down a keepsake or share tea. Premium indie social space, warm and mature, not Sims HUD, not Animal Crossing copy.

Title text "C / LIFE IN SCENES" and subtitle "Character-led 3D". PRODUCT: a small directed slice-of-life stage with attractive adult anime CG avatars, genuine spatial lighting and a few authored camera angles. Make art visibly 3D cel/soft-toon shaded with sculpted volume, dimensioned hair, precise silhouettes, naturally shaded hands and clothes, not flat illustration and not photoreal humans. Grown-up appealing woman with loose dark bob oatmeal cardigan, handsome grown-up man short dark hair muted teal sweater. Both users' bodies present, the scene is NOT a girlfriend looking at a disembodied camera. Close 50mm-style seated camera from beside the table shows both people, eye contact and shared quiet, strongly shaped cool rim/amber key lighting. Sophisticated blue hour room, window glass rain, velvet moss sofa, dark walnut table, one softly shaded lamp. Frame foremost tea cup at near edge, characters at medium depth, night window deep behind; shallow focus only on far backdrop, both faces clear. Main action: she turns toward her friend and slides a little note across the table. Bottom left: a second authored close two-shot of the SAME two adults receiving the note, proves another camera angle (no free-roam joystick). Bottom right: authored wider FOUR-person shot in SAME space, two on sofa two on side chairs, all adults, distinct looks, bodies grounded with contact shadows. Fashion and skin tasteful, no giant glossy eyes, no glamour boudoir, no gacha character banners. Lighting dramatic but sustained-view comfortable. Scene production ambition higher than B, while all UI remains restrained and legible.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE visually distinctive premium concept board for a private shared-room app OUR WORLD, titled "B / OUR LITTLE PLACE", subtitle "A small place to play together". Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. THIS DIRECTION MUST BE AN OPEN-WALL MINIATURE 3D ROOM WITH VISIBLE FLOOR PLAN AND INTERACTABLE OBJECTS, not a close-up of a couple's faces. Main left 76% of board: desktop app window with a beautiful CUTAWAY THREE-QUARTER 3D ROOM occupying 65% of window and opaque ivory readable chat sidebar occupying 35%. Right 24%: tall phone preview with room composed in upper 50% and chat below. Bottom quarter: two wide inset scenes, left hand placing a wooden block on tabletop, right FOUR FRIENDS IN THE SAME CUTAWAY ROOM with readable spatial seat arrangement. Refined quiet charcoal/cream presentation. The main scene is a compact asymmetrical attic lounge, pitched roof absent for camera, two standing walls and open front, camera at 30 degree downward angle. Make ALL couch, two chairs, a low table, the rug floor, window, record player cabinet visible. Hero scene should read like a tiny inhabitable physical place with deep geometrical projection, chunky rounded structural silhouettes, not a regular photography living room. Do NOT place gigantic portraits. Avatars are stylized grown-up cartoon people, around 4.5 to 5 head proportions, figures about 28 percent of room-view height, recognizably mature casual outfits, sculpted simple hair, tiny but expressive faces. Dark bob adult woman in oatmeal cardigan and wavy dark-haired adult man teal sweater. One sits on sofa, one sits in low chair, both interacting around a low toy table; include two empty credible friend seats. Material style: elegant hand-painted textures on simplified 3D geometry, visible form and matte shading, wood and wool, no physically rendered knit pores or movie-perfect human skin. Forest green, golden honey, muted terracotta, slate blue. Strong late afternoon slanting light through ONE thick framed window onto floor, crisp coherent window cast shadow, dark cool under-furniture contact shadows, warm indirect fill; a glimpse of blue rain cloud sky outside. Beautiful and tactile, NOT childish, not toy box plastic, not Lego, not an existing game IP. Table has a tiny four-block balancing game and two tea cups. Dresser has a music box. Room is uncluttered so objects can be seen at phone size. Restrained UI top "Our World", "Room", "Chat", "Memories", "Music"; sidebar "Chat", messages "Your turn.", "One more block?", "I'll stay for a song."; music footer "Evening together". Phone preserves deliberate two-avatar framing and readable UI, not desktop squeezed. Four-person inset has four distinct adult user avatars at four seats around table, room stays the SAME footprint. All image content is ASPIRATIONAL DESIGN, not actual rendered performance evidence. No gameplay meters, hearts, quests, chores, XP, coins, joystick, virtual companion NPCs, children, slogans beyond requested, photoreal humans, excessive tiny text or watermark. Prioritize architecture and physical interaction over romance portraits.
